name: cold-start
description: Launch from cold, warm and hot; p50 and p95 per state.

app_id.description: The package to launch. Falls back to suite.app_id.

launches.description: Measured launches per state, after one discarded warm-up launch.

states.description: Which launch states to measure. Each result row records the state the framework reported, which can differ from the one asked for.

params.description: Android only: iOS targets get a failed row naming why there is no honest time-to-first-frame. The app must already be installed; a device without it is skipped.
